intro: Tourism is the biggest part of Montenegro's small economy.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Visitors come for the beaches, Kotor, the island village of Sveti Stefan and the mountains. Aluminium, electricity and farming are other industries.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: A motorway built with a large Chinese loan sparked worries about the country's debt.

keyTerms.meaning: Money borrowed that must be paid back.
